items.title: Jimmie "Kid" Clayton Interview
items.q: I had a fine wife, she's dead. I married again, I got another fine wife. You see that? Yeah. You ever been to him? Yeah.

ctx.x: I wouldn't spend something, he wouldn't let me. I'm telling you, you go bring this money home to Miss Lucia. That's what he'd take. Yeah, I had a fine wife, she's dead. I married again, I got another fine wife. You see that? Yeah. You ever been to him? Yeah.
Yeah, I knew you, I'd be very much, very fine wife. Well I think that looks like the end of it there. Alright, you spell it. Wrap her up. Wrap her up.
